name: GTI Resources Limited
summary: GTI Resources Limited engages in the exploration and evaluation of mineral tenements in Australia and the United States. It explores its Utah Uranium and Vanadium project, which covers an area of approximately 1500 hectares located in the Henry Mountains, Utah; Niagara Gold project located in Western Australia; and Reach project located in Western Australia. The company was incorporated in 2007 and is based in Perth, Australia.
